question: A convex lens forms a real image at $60\text{ cm}$ when an object is placed $30\text{ cm}$ in front of it. Find the focal length of the lens and its power.

options.B: With $u=-30\text{ cm}$ and $v=+60\text{ cm}$, $\dfrac{1}{f}=\dfrac{1}{60}-\dfrac{1}{-30}=\dfrac{1}{20}$. Thus $f=+20\text{ cm}=0.20\text{ m}$ and $P=+5\text{ D}$.
